summary: XOMA Royalty Corp filed this 8-K/A to supplement its earlier report on the completion of its acquisition of Generation Bio Co. via a tender offer. Under the Merger Agreement dated December 15, 2025, XOMA's subsidiary, XRA 7 Corp., acquired all Generation Bio common shares for $4.2913 cash per share plus one non-tradeable contingent value right (CVR), representing potential future cash payments. The tender offer closed on February 6, 2026, and the merger followed shortly. No board recommendation or advisor is named in this excerpt. The CVR mechanics and potential milestone payments warrant watching for risk-arb considerations.
